Method of Attack: Phishing campaign targeting tax preparation firms and individuals with emails containing links to ZIP archives disguised as tax forms. The ZIP archives contain Windows shortcuts (.lnk) that execute PowerShell to download obfuscated VBS scripts. The VBS scripts download and execute GuLoader malware, which installs the Remcos remote access trojan (RAT). The RAT provides initial access to corporate networks, enabling lateral movement, data theft, and deployment of additional malware.
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious links leading to ZIP archives containing Windows shortcut files that execute PowerShell commands to download and run malware.
